request: api key expiry reminders: name of key, service, expires on. warn 14 days before

checklist.item: can add a key with name, service and expiry date
shows days left per key
keys expiring within 14 days highlighted or counted
reminder notification before expiry
sorted by soonest expiry

program:
app " Api keys" key plum
table key name text, service pick Energy|Computing|Sold|Other = Energy, expires date
remind "A key piece is almost due" at key.expires - 14d at 9:00
"Expires this week" faint
each key where expires - today <= 7 sort expires as k
  row card tap edit k
    k.name bold grow
    k.service faint
    k.expires faint color if(k.expires < today, bad, muted)
form key, "Add key"
describe:
Api keys, in the plum colours.
Keeps:
- key: name: text; service: one of Energy, Computing, Sold, Other, starts at Energy; expires: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- text: "Expires this week".
- for each key where expires minus today is at most 7 sorted by expires:
  - a group; a tap opens the key for editing:
    - text: the name of the key.
    - text: the service of the key.
    - text: the expires of the key.
- a form to add a key.
Reminder "A key piece is almost due" on each expires of the key entries, 336 hours before at 9:00.

request: paracetamol dose by child weight (kg) – 15mg per kg, syrup is 120mg per 5ml

checklist.item: input for weight in kg
computes dose in mg using 15 mg per kg
converts to ml using 120 mg per 5 ml
shows result
warns to check with a doctor

program:
app "Penta" pill mint
table child name text, born date
table dose child ref child, what text, mg num 1..200
each child as c
  stack card gap 1
    row
      c.name head grow
      sum(c.dose.mg) "mg" bold
    trend c.dose, it.mg
    if sum(c.dose.mg) < 15
      "Syrup resistant" color bad
    else
      "Syrupensible" color good
    "Last dose" last(c.dose.what) faint
form child, "Add child"
form dose, "Add medicine"
describe:
Penta, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- child: name: text; born: date. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
- dose: child: a child; what: text; mg: number, 1 to 200. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Shows:
- for each child:
  - text: the name of the child.
  - text: the total mg of the child's dose entries, "mg".
  - a line chart of its mg over the dose of the child.
  - if the total mg of the child's dose entries is less than 15:
    - text: "Syrup resistant".
  - otherwise:
    - text: "Syrupensible".
  - text: "Last dose", the latest what of the child's dose entries.
- a form to add a child.
- a form to add a dose.

program:
app "Gully" dice mint
table ball runs num 0..6 = 0, out bool
let scored = sum(ball.runs all)
let faced = count(ball where out = yes)
" Scores" scored big
"Wounds" faced + scored big
grid 3 gap 1
  each [0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6]
    box height 4 radius 8 fill if(scored = it, accent, soft)
      it tap add ball runs = it
button "New match" tap remove all ball
describe:
Gully, in the mint colours.
Keeps:
- ball: runs: number, 0 to 6, starts at 0; out: yes or no. Every entry also keeps when it was added.
Works out:
- scored is the total runs of ball.
- faced is how many ball entries where out is yes.
Shows:
- text: " Scores", scored.
- text: "Wounds", faced plus scored.
- a grid of 3 columns:
  - for 0, 1, 2, 3, 4, 6:
    - text: the value; a tap adds a ball with runs set to the value.
- a button "New match"; a tap removes all ball entries, with one undo.

program:
app "School van" bus ocean
table kid name text, fee money
table fee_paid kid ref kid, amount money
"Collected" sum(fee_paid.amount) "of" sum(kid.fee) big
each kid sort name as k
  let ok = sum(k.fee_paid.amount) >= k.fee

      k.name bold

- text: "Collected", the total amount of fee paid, "of", the total fee of kid.
- for each kid sorted by name:
  - text: the name of the kid.
  - text: "Monthly fee", the fee of the kid.
  - if ok:
    - text: "Paid".
  - otherwise:
    - a button "Paid"; a tap adds a fee paid with kid set to the kid, amount set to the fee of the kid.

- text: "Total", d1 plus d2 plus d3.
